svg.text: Power supplies, bypass capacitors and control pins
Red = supply rail. Gray = GND return. Capacitors shown in the same group connect in parallel.
1 Regulated 5 V input, switch and analog regulator
USB power reaches the Tiny through its kit adapter.
2 Supply capacitors: each branch goes to GND
C3 is drawn at U2 above. Each protection IC also has 100 nF.
3 Internal reference and internal regulator capacitors
U1 pin 25 (VREFN) → GND. ∥ means parallel components.
4 ADS1296 supply pins and digital bypass
Pin 60 uses the internal RLD reference in this design.
5 Pull resistors and fixed logic settings
Supply capacitors are parallel branches between a rail and GND. The two 3.3 V rails are separate named nets. This is an explanatory wiring view.
